hazards.location_in_image: Center-right, where the chain-link fence opens for the truck repair lot.

hazards.name: Poor Sidewalk Maintenance
hazards.description: Significant weed growth and cracking in the concrete slabs create potential tripping hazards.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and mid-ground across the entire sidewalk width.

hazards.name: Lack of separated sidewalk
hazards.description: There is no dedicated space for pedestrians, forcing them to walk on the shoulder or in the roadway alongside motor vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Both sides of the roadway throughout the visible stretch

hazards.name: Uncontrolled vehicle access points
hazards.description: Multiple wide driveways for industrial sites and a gas station create frequent conflict points between vehicles and pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Left and right sides of the roadway

hazards.name: High-speed road design
hazards.description: Wide travel lanes and a lack of traffic calming measures encourage high vehicle speeds, increasing the risk of severe injury.
hazards.location_in_image: Main travel lanes in the center of the image

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross a wide, multi-lane road without designated markings or signals.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the roadway at the junction point.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Refuge
hazards.description: The absence of a median or refuge island forces pedestrians to cross all lanes in one movement, increasing exposure time.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the roadway along the double yellow lines.

hazards.name: High-speed roadway design
hazards.description: Multiple wide travel lanes with no traffic calming encourage high vehicle speeds adjacent to the walkway.
hazards.location_in_image: Center and left of the image, the main roadway.

hazards.name: Degraded sidewalk surface
hazards.description: The sidewalk on the right is cracked with significant weed growth, creating tripping hazards and reducing accessibility.

hazards.name: Lack of safe crossings
hazards.description: No marked crosswalks or pedestrian refuge areas are visible across a very wide multi-lane road.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the entire width of the roadway.

hazards.name: Lack of Buffer
hazards.description: There is no physical separation or furniture zone between the wide sidewalk and the travel lanes, leaving pedestrians exposed to traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curb line separating the sidewalk from the road.

hazards.name: Pavement Deterioration
hazards.description: Cracks and weeds growing through the sidewalk surface create minor trip hazards and indicate poor maintenance.
hazards.location_in_image: Scattered across the paved sidewalk area.

hazards.name: Frequent Driveway Conflicts
hazards.description: Multiple wide curb cuts for industrial access create numerous points where vehicles cross the pedestrian path.

hazards.name: Poor Sidewalk Surface and Obstructions
hazards.description: The paved walkway is cracked, uneven, and obstructed by utility poles and a fire hydrant.

hazards.name: Lack of Crossing Infrastructure
hazards.description: There are no marked crosswalks, pedestrian signals, or warning signs visible for pedestrians to safely traverse the arterial.

hazards.name: Missing Sidewalk
hazards.description: There is no paved sidewalk visible on the near side of the street where the camera is positioned.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median or refuge island to break up the long crossing distance across five lanes of traffic.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening and Buffering
interventions.description: Widen the existing narrow sidewalk and add a landscaped buffer with street trees to protect pedestrians from traffic.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crossing
interventions.description: Implement a high-visibility marked crosswalk with appropriate signage or a pedestrian-activated signal.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Landscaping
interventions.description: Install a planting strip with street trees to provide a physical and psychological buffer between pedestrians and vehicles.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Add street lighting specifically designed for the sidewalk to improve visibility and safety at night.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Islands
interventions.description: Install a median or refuge island to break up the long crossing distance across the multi-lane road.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Add marked crossings with high-visibility paint and signage to improve pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening and Landscaping
interventions.description: Widen the sidewalk and add street trees to provide a physical and psychological buffer from traffic.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Hybrid Beacon (HAWK)
interventions.description: Implement a signalized crossing to stop traffic and provide a protected interval for pedestrians to cross the multi-lane road.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Construction with Buffer
interventions.description: Build a continuous, ADA-compliant sidewalk system with a landscape buffer to provide a safe, dedicated space for walking.

interventions.title: Protected Sidewalk and Buffer
interventions.description: Install a raised sidewalk with a landscaped buffer or furniture zone to provide physical and psychological separation from moving vehicles.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Vertical Friction
interventions.description: Plant street trees along the roadway to provide shade and create 'vertical friction' that naturally encourages drivers to slow down.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening
interventions.description: Widen the sidewalk or install a curb extension to provide a consistent clear walking width around the utility pole.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Greenery
interventions.description: Introduce street trees or planters to create a physical buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway and improve the pedestrian experience.

interventions.title: Road Diet
interventions.description: Reduce the number of travel lanes to slow traffic and provide space for enhanced pedestrian infrastructure and wider buffers.

interventions.title: Raised Sidewalk
interventions.description: Construct a raised concrete sidewalk to provide vertical separation and physical protection for pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a marked crossing with signage and potentially a refuge island to facilitate safe passage across the wide roadway.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct a continuous, ADA-compliant sidewalk separated from the roadway by a curb or buffer.

interventions.title: Driveway Consolidation and Access Management
interventions.description: Replace the continuous apron with defined, narrow driveway entrances to reduce conflict points and provide a continuous sidewalk level.

interventions.title: Road Diet and Pedestrian Crossings
interventions.description: Reduce the number of travel lanes to include a center turn lane or median and install marked mid-block crossings with refuge islands.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at driveways and potential crossing points to reduce crossing distance and slow turning traffic.

interventions.title: Delineated Walkway
interventions.description: Use high-visibility paint or textured pavement to clearly define the pedestrian path across the industrial driveways to alert drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Warning Signage
interventions.description: Install signs to alert drivers to the presence of pedestrians, especially near garage exits and industrial access points.

interventions.title: Physical Buffers or Bollards
interventions.description: Install bollards at the edges of the pedestrian path to prevent vehicles from encroaching on the walkway except at designated access points.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Rehabilitation
interventions.description: Repair and widen the existing sidewalk to provide a smooth, accessible walking surface.

interventions.title: Protected Bike Lane Upgrade
interventions.description: Replace the flexible bollards with a permanent concrete curb to better protect the bike lane and provide a more substantial buffer for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Access Management
interventions.description: Install curbing and defined driveway aprons to limit vehicle entry/exit points and protect the pedestrian path.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Crossing Improvements
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with a pedestrian refuge island and high-visibility signage or signals.

interventions.title: Raised Sidewalk and Curb
interventions.description: Construct a standard raised sidewalk with a vertical curb to provide a dedicated and physically protected space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Buffer Zone
interventions.description: Add a planting strip or furniture zone between the roadway and the sidewalk to increase the distance between pedestrians and moving vehicles.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planting Strip
interventions.description: Install a landscaped buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway to provide physical separation and improve the microclimate.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair and Leveling
interventions.description: Resurface the sidewalk to remove weeds and repair cracks, ensuring a smooth and accessible walking surface.

interventions.title: Construct ADA-Compliant Sidewalks
interventions.description: Install continuous, paved sidewalks on both sides of the street to provide physical separation between pedestrians and motor vehicles.

interventions.title: Lane Narrowing and Road Diet
interventions.description: Reduce the width of travel lanes to encourage slower vehicle speeds and repurpose space for a pedestrian buffer or bike lane.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks and Signage
interventions.description: Install high-visibility crosswalks and pedestrian warning signs to provide safe crossing opportunities across the wide roadway.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crossing with Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk and a raised median refuge island to reduce crossing distance and exposure.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planters
interventions.description: Install a row of street trees or large planters to create a physical buffer between the sidewalk and the road.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Midblock Crossings
interventions.description: Install marked crosswalks with pedestrian refuge islands to reduce crossing distance and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalk and Signalization
interventions.description: Install high-visibility crosswalks and a pedestrian-actuated signal or HAWK beacon to create a protected crossing point.
